# 1. Data

```{r Packages, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(readxl) # Import excel files
library(tidyverse) # Visualization and Wrangling
library(janitor) # Visualization and Wrangling
library(rjags) # Packge for Bayesian model implementation - Posterior sampler
library(gridExtra) # Visualization
```

```{r Preparation}
# Read the data
data <- read_excel("Disease long - FRL.xlsx")

# Calculating y*
N <- as.numeric(nrow(data))
data$y_star <- (((data$sev/100)*(N-1))+(1/2))/N

# Prepare data for case studies
df_cs1 <- data %>%
  filter(trt %in% c(3, 4), year == "2024", var == "KS18B")

df_cs1_osv <- data %>%
  filter(trt %in% c(3, 4), year == "2023", var == "KS18B")

df_cs2 <- data %>%
  filter(trt == 2, year == "2024", var == "SY Monument")
```

# 2. Prior prediction

```{r PriorPred}
# Iteration number and day in which we want to make a prediction
k <- 5000
x <- seq(0, 55, by = 1)

# Save the samples
prior.pred.y <- matrix(NA, nrow = k, ncol = length(x))
prior.pred.mu <- matrix(NA, nrow = k, ncol = length(x))

sample.y_0 <- rep(0, k)
sample.K <- rep(0, k)
sample.r <- rep(0, k)
sample.phi <- rep(0, k)

set.seed(1996)

for(i in 1:k) {
  
  # Sample from assumed prior distributions
  y_0 = runif(1, 0.001, 0.1)
  K = rbeta(1, 6, 2)
  r = runif(1, 0, 0.5)
  phi = rgamma(1, 24, 2)
  
  # Prior predictions
  ## Process model
  mu = K/(1 + ((K-y_0)/y_0)*exp(-r*x))
  
  ## Prior predictive draws from data model
  alpha = mu*phi
  beta = (1-mu)*phi
  y <- rbeta(length(x), alpha, beta)
  
  ## Saving prior predictive draws
  prior.pred.mu[i, ] <- mu
  prior.pred.y[i, ] <- y
  
  # Save the parameter samples
  sample.y_0[i] <- y_0
  sample.K[i] <- K
  sample.r[i] <- r
  sample.phi[i] <- phi
  
}

# Datasets with prior predictions - Parameters + Simulated y
par.prior.pred <- data.frame(
  y_0 = sample.y_0,
  K = sample.K,
  r = sample.r,
  phi = sample.phi
)

y.prior.pred <- data.frame()

for(i in seq_along(x)){
  temp <- data.frame(
    day = x[i],
    y.sim = prior.pred.y[, i],
    mu.sim = prior.pred.mu[, i])
  
  y.prior.pred <- rbind(y.prior.pred, temp)
}

# 50 predicted curves (mean)
ppred_mu <- data.frame(prior.pred.mu)
ppred_50 <- ppred_mu[sample(nrow(ppred_mu), 50, replace = FALSE), ]
colnames(ppred_50) <- seq(0, 55, by = 1)

ppred_50$id <- 1:nrow(ppred_50)

ppred_50_l <- pivot_longer(ppred_50, cols = 1:56, values_to = "p_draw", names_to = "time")

ppred_50_l$time <- as.numeric(ppred_50_l$time)
ppred_50_l <- arrange(ppred_50_l, time, by_group = id)
```

# 3. Model fit

## 3.1. Case study 1

### 3.1.1. Model fit, posterior prediction, and derived quantities

```{r cs1 model fit}
# Initialization
df <- df_cs1

## Posterior prediction and derived quantitity components
x.new <- seq(1, 55)
N_pred <- length(x.new)
lower <- min(x.new)
upper <- max(x.new)

## Data and initial values
df <- df %>%
  mutate(tim_id = case_when(
    tim == "Feekes 7" ~ 1,
    tim == "Feekes 9" ~ 2
  ))

data_lines <- list(
  "y" = df$y_star, 
  "tim" = df$tim_id, 
  "x" = df$time_days, 
  "N" = nrow(df), 
  "N_t" = length(unique(df$tim_id)), 
  "x.new" = x.new, 
  "N_pred" = N_pred,
  "lower" = lower,
  "upper" = upper
) # Data and sizes of groups

initials <- list(
  "K" = rep(0.5, length(unique(df$tim_id))), 
  "y0" = rep(0.05, length(unique(df$tim_id))), 
  "r" = rep(0.3, length(unique(df$tim_id))), 
  "phi" = rep(0.1, length(unique(df$tim_id)))
) # Initial values for each chain

# Writting the model

model_jags_string <- "model {
  
  # Model
  ## Likelihood
  for(i in 1:N){
    y[i] ~ dbeta(alpha[i], beta[i])
    
    alpha[i] <- mu[i]*phi[tim[i]]
    beta[i] <- (1-mu[i])*phi[tim[i]]
    
    mu[i] <- K[tim[i]]/(1+((K[tim[i]]-y0[tim[i]])/y0[tim[i]])*exp(-r[tim[i]]*x[i]))
  
    # Posterior replicated observation for calibration check
    y_rep[i] ~ dbeta(alpha[i], beta[i])
  
  }
  
  ## Priors
  for(t in 1:N_t){
    phi[t] ~ dgamma(24, 2)
    K[t] ~ dbeta(6, 2)
    y0[t] ~ dunif(0.001, 0.1)
    r[t] ~ dunif(0, 0.5)
  }
  
  # Posterior prediction
  for(t in 1:N_t){
    for(j in 1:N_pred){
      y_pred[t,j] ~ dbeta(alpha.new[t,j], beta.new[t,j])
      
      alpha.new[t,j] <- mu.pred[t,j]*phi[t]
      beta.new[t,j] <- (1-mu.pred[t,j])*phi[t]
      
      mu.pred[t,j] <- K[t]/(1+((K[t]-y0[t])/y0[t])*exp(-r[t]*x.new[j]))
    }
  }
  
  # Derived quantities
  ## AUDPC
  for(t in 1:N_t){
  
  A[t] <- (K[t] - y0[t])/y0[t]
  
  AUDPC[t] <- (K[t]/r[t])*(log(exp(r[t]*upper)+A[t])-log(exp(r[t]*lower)+A[t]))
  }
  
  ## Maximum instantaneous rate of disease increase
  for(t in 1:N_t){
  r_star[t] <- (K[t]*r[t])/4
  }
  
  ## Posterior contrasts
  D_K <- K[1] - K[2]
  D_r <- r[1] - r[2]
  D_AUDPC <- AUDPC[1] - AUDPC[2]
  D_r_star <- r_star[1] - r_star[2]
  
}"

# Fitting the model
m1 <- jags.model(textConnection(model_jags_string), inits = initials, data = data_lines, n.chains = 3) # Initialize the chains

update(m1, n.iter = 5000) # Burn-in / Adaptation

m1_samples <- coda.samples(m1, variable.names = c("K", "r", "y0", "phi", "y_pred", "AUDPC", "y_rep", "r_star", "D_K", "D_r", "D_AUDPC", "D_r_star"), n.iter = 10000) # Samples from the posterior distribution

# Constructing a df with the results
post_df1 <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(m1_samples))
```

```{r summaries CS1}
quantile(post_df1$`K[1]`, c(0.025, 0.975))

# r
```

### 3.1.4. Posterior predictive checks

```{r cs1 model check}
# In sample posterior predictive check
y.rep_df1 <- select(post_df1, starts_with("y_rep"))

y.rep1_sum <- apply(y.rep_df1, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

y.rep1_sum <- t(y.rep1_sum)

ppc1_check <- data.frame(
  tim_id = df$tim_id,
  observed = df$y_star,
  PPI.L = y.rep1_sum[, "2.5%"],
  PPI.U = y.rep1_sum[, "97.5%"]
)

ppc1_check$covered <- with(ppc1_check, observed >= PPI.L & observed <= PPI.U)

mean(ppc1_check$covered) # Overall

ppc1_check %>%
  group_by(tim_id) %>%
  summarise(covered = mean(covered)) # By treatment

# Out of sample posterior predictive check
post_pred <- post_df1[,c("y_pred[1,31]", "y_pred[1,42]", "y_pred[1,53]", "y_pred[2,31]", "y_pred[2,42]", "y_pred[2,53]")]

post.pred_sum <- apply(post_pred, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

post.pred_sum <- t(post.pred_sum)

df_cs1_osv <- df_cs1_osv %>%
  mutate(
    PPI.L = case_when(
      time_days == 31 & tim == "Feekes 7" ~ post.pred_sum[1, 1],
      time_days == 42 & tim == "Feekes 7" ~ post.pred_sum[2, 1],
      time_days == 53 & tim == "Feekes 7" ~ post.pred_sum[3, 1],
      time_days == 31 & tim == "Feekes 9" ~ post.pred_sum[4, 1],
      time_days == 42 & tim == "Feekes 9" ~ post.pred_sum[5, 1],
      time_days == 53 & tim == "Feekes 9" ~ post.pred_sum[6, 1]),
    
    PPI.U = case_when(
      time_days == 31 & tim == "Feekes 7" ~ post.pred_sum[1, 2],
      time_days == 42 & tim == "Feekes 7" ~ post.pred_sum[2, 2],
      time_days == 53 & tim == "Feekes 7" ~ post.pred_sum[3, 2],
      time_days == 31 & tim == "Feekes 9" ~ post.pred_sum[4, 2],
      time_days == 42 & tim == "Feekes 9" ~ post.pred_sum[5, 2],
      time_days == 53 & tim == "Feekes 9" ~ post.pred_sum[6, 2]))

df_cs1_osv$covered <- with(df_cs1_osv, y_star >= PPI.L & y_star <= PPI.U)

mean(df_cs1_osv$covered) # Overall

df_cs1_osv %>%
  group_by(tim) %>%
  summarise(covered = mean(covered)) # By treatment
```

## 3.2. Case study 2

### 3.2.1. Model fit, posterior prediction, and derived quantities

```{r cs2 model fit}
# Initialization
df <- df_cs2

## Posterior prediction components
x.new <- seq(1, 55)
N_pred <- length(x.new)

## Data and initial values
data_lines <- list(
  "y" = df$y_star, 
  "x" = df$time_days, 
  "N" = nrow(df), 
  "x.new" = x.new, 
  "N_pred" = N_pred
) # Data and sizes of groups

initials <- list(
  "K" = rep(0.5), 
  "y0" = rep(0.05), 
  "r" = rep(0.3), 
  "phi" = rep(0.1)
) # Initial values for each chain

# Writting the model

model_jags_string <- "model {
  
  # Likelihood
  for(i in 1:N){
    y[i] ~ dbeta(alpha[i], beta[i])
    
    alpha[i] <- mu[i]*phi
    beta[i] <- (1-mu[i])*phi
    
    mu[i] <- K/(1+((K-y0)/y0)*exp(-r*x[i]))
    
    # Posterior replicated observation for calibration check
    y_rep[i] ~ dbeta(alpha[i], beta[i])
  }
  
  # Priors
    phi ~ dgamma(24, 2)
    K ~ dbeta(6, 2)
    y0 ~ dunif(0.001, 0.1)
    r ~ dunif(0, 0.5)
  
  # Posterior prediction
  for(j in 1:N_pred){
    y_pred[j] ~ dbeta(alpha.new[j], beta.new[j])
      
    alpha.new[j] <- mu.pred[j]*phi
    beta.new[j] <- (1-mu.pred[j])*phi
      
    mu.pred[j] <- K/(1+((K-y0)/y0)*exp(-r*x.new[j]))
    }
}"

# Fitting the model
m2 <- jags.model(textConnection(model_jags_string), inits = initials, data = data_lines, n.chains = 3) # Initialize the chains

update(m2, n.iter = 5000) # Burn-in / Adaptation

m2_samples <- coda.samples(m2, variable.names = c("K", "r", "y0", "phi", "y_pred", "y_rep"), n.iter = 10000) # Samples from the posterior distribution

# Checking results - Example
post_df2 <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(m2_samples))
```

```{r summaries CS2}
quantile(post_df2$K, c(0.025, 0.975))
```

# 4. Supplementary code

<br><br>

## 4.1. Model with blocks as random

```{r SupCode, eval=FALSE}
model_jags_string <- "model {
  
  # Likelihood
  for(i in 1:N){
    y[i] ~ dbeta(alpha[i], beta[i])
    
    alpha[i] <- mu[i]*phi
    beta[i] <- (1-mu[i])*phi
    
    mu[i] <- 1/(1+exp(-mu_logit[i]))
      
    mu_logit[i] <- log(mu_curve[i]/(1-mu_curve[i])) + b_eff[block[i]]
    
    mu_curve[i] <- K[trt[i]]/(1+((K[trt[i]]-y0[trt[i]])/y0[trt[i]])*exp(-r[trt[i]]*x[i]))
  }
  
  # Prior distributions
  for(t in 1:N_t){
    K[t] ~ dbeta(6, 2)
    y0[t] ~ dunif(0.001, 0.1)
    r[t] ~ dunif(0, 0.5)
  }
  
  phi ~ dgamma(24, 2)
  tau ~ dgamma(4, 2)
  
  for(l in 1:N_b){
    b_eff[l] ~ dnorm(0, tau)
  }
  
  sigma_b <- 1/sqrt(tau)
  
  # Posterior prediction (marginal)
  
  b_new ~ dnorm(0, tau)
  
  for(t in 1:N_t){
    for(j in 1:N_pred){
      y_pred[t,j] ~ dbeta(alpha.new[t,j], beta.new[t,j])
      
      alpha.new[t,j] <- mu.pred[t,j]*phi
      beta.new[t,j] <- (1-mu.pred[t,j])*phi
      
      mu.pred[t,j] <- 1/(1+exp(-mu.b[t,j]))
      
      mu.b[t,j] <- log(mu.raw[t,j]/(1-mu.raw[t,j])) + b_new
      
      mu.raw[t,j] <- K[t]/(1+((K[t]-y0[t])/y0[t])*exp(-r[t]*x.new[j]))
    }
  }
  
  # Derived quantities (AUDPC)
  for(t in 1:N_t){
  
  A[t] <- (K[t] - y0[t])/y0[t]
  
  AUDPC[t] <- (K[t]/r[t])*(log(exp(r[t]*upper)+A[t])-log(exp(r[t]*lower)+A[t]))
  }
}"
```

## Figure 1 - Prior prediction

```{r Fig1}
y.prior.sum <- y.prior.pred %>%
  group_by(day) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(y.sim), lower = quantile(y.sim, 0.025), upper = quantile(y.sim, 0.975))

fig1_a <- ggplot(y.prior.sum, aes(x = day, y = mean)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "sans"), plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)) +
  labs(x = "Day", y = "Prior predicted severity (prop.)", tag = "a")

fig1_b <- ggplot(ppred_50_l, aes(time, p_draw, group = id)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "sans"), , plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)) +
  labs(x = "Day", y = "Prior predicted severity (prop.)", tag = "b")

fig1 <- grid.arrange(fig1_a, fig1_b, ncol = 1)
```

## Figure 4 - CS1 posterior predicted curves

- Data from: 3.1.1. Model fit, posterior prediction, and derived quantities

```{r Fig4}
post_df <- select(post_df1, starts_with("y_pred"))

post.df_sum <- data.frame(
  mean = apply(post_df, 2, mean),
  PPI.L = apply(post_df, 2, quantile, 0.025),
  PPI.U = apply(post_df, 2, quantile, 0.975)
)

post.df_sum$id <- row.names(post.df_sum)

post.df_sum <- post.df_sum %>%
  separate(id, c("id", "temp"), sep = "\\[") %>%
  separate(temp, c("trt", "day"), sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(day = gsub("\\]", "", day)) %>%
  transform(day = as.numeric(day))

fig4 <- ggplot(post.df_sum, aes(day, mean, group = trt, colour = trt, fill = trt)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = PPI.L, ymax = PPI.U), alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_point(data = df_cs1, aes(x = time_days, y = y_star, shape = tim), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_discrete_manual(name = "App. timing", aesthetics = c("colour", "fill"), values = c("1" = "#cf4446", "2" = "#781c6d"), labels = c("1" = "Feekes 7", "2" = "Feekes 9")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  guides(shape = "none") +
  labs(y = "Posterior predicted severity (prop.)", x = "Day")

#ggsave("Fig4.tiff", plot = fig4, width = 170, height = 110, units = "mm", dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
```

# 6. Sup. figures

<br><br>

## Supplementary Figure 1

```{r SupFig1}
set.seed(1996)

prior.fig <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(par = "K", x = seq(0, 1, length.out = 1000)) %>%
  mutate(density = dbeta(x, 6, 2)),
  
  data.frame(par = "r", x = seq(0, 0.5, length.out = 1000)) %>%
    mutate(density = dunif(x, 0, 0.5)),
  
  data.frame(par = "y0", x = seq(0.001, 0.1, length.out = 1000)) %>%
    mutate(density = dunif(x, 0.001, 0.1)),
  
  data.frame(par = "phi", x = seq(0, 30, length.out = 1000)) %>%
    mutate(density = dgamma(x, 24, 2))
  )

SupFig1 <- ggplot(prior.fig, aes(x = x, y = density)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~par, scales = "free", labeller = as_labeller(c(K = "K", r = "r", y0 = "y[0]", phi = "phi"), label_parsed)) +
  labs(x = "Parameter value", y = "Prior density") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 14))

#ggsave("SupFig1.tiff", plot = SupFig1, width = 170, height = 110, units = "mm") #Half page: 85 mm wide / Full page: 170 mm wide / Max height: 225 mm / 300 dpi
```

## Supplementary Figure 2

- Data from: 1. Data

```{r SupFig2}
data$prod <- fct_relevel(data$prod, c("Nexicor", "Tebustar", "Topguard", "Prosaro", "Headline", "Healthy", "Untreated"))
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    var_id = case_when(
      var == "KS18B" ~ "KS 180B",
      var == "SY Monument" ~ "SY Monument"),
    
    season = case_when(
      year == "2023" ~ "2022-2023",
      year == "2024" ~ "2023-2024")
    
    )

SupFig2 <- ggplot(data, aes(time_days, y_star, colour = tim)) +
  geom_point() +
  stat_summary(geom="line", fun=mean) +
  facet_grid(season*var_id~prod) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "App. timing", aesthetics = c("colour"), values = c("Untreated" = "#09622A", "Healthy" = "#21538B", "Feekes 7" = "#cf4446", "Feekes 9" = "#781c6d")) +
  labs(y = "y*", x = "Days after FGS 7")

#ggsave("SupFig2.tiff", SupFig2, dpi = 300, units = "mm", width = 300, height = 170)
```
